preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10,000.
The coordinates of the points are between 0 and 10^9.

preconditions.expression: All points are different in one test case.
preconditions.description: Each point in a test case is unique.

postconditions.description: The minimum number of steps to make a square is non-negative for each test case.
The output for each test case is the minimum number of steps required to form a square with sides parallel to the axes.
